blocks.title: Business
blocks.text: Seagate provides mass-capacity data storage. HDDs are described as foundational for scalable, energy-efficient mass-capacity storage, with favorable storage economics. The company says it combines vertically integrated engineering and manufacturing with investment in storage technologies.

evidence.quote: Hard disk drives (“HDDs”) remain a foundational technology for delivering scalable, energy-efficient, mass-capacity storage with favorable storage economics

cells: High-capacity HDDs up to 44TB and storage systems up to 3.5PB; designed for AI-enabled cloud computing, business-critical applications, content delivery, backup, and archive.

evidence.quote: Our Data Center portfolio includes high-capacity HDDs of up to 44TB and storage systems of up to 3.5PB.

cells: Storage products from 1TB to 32TB for data created, processed, and stored closer to its source; applications include video and image, NAS, smart infrastructure, personal computing, gaming, streaming, creative workflows, and backup.

evidence.quote: Our Edge IoT portfolio includes storage products ranging from 1TB to 32TB to enable applications where data is created, processed and stored closer to its source.

blocks.title: Demand context
blocks.text: The company attributes long-term support for mass-capacity storage demand to growing data creation, cloud infrastructure expansion, data-center modernization, AI applications, longer retention, greater replication, and regulatory requirements. It says most of its business is derived from Data Center markets; demand there can fluctuate with customer procurement schedules, IT spending, and hyperscale investment timing.

evidence.quote: The vast majority of our business is derived from the Data Center markets.

blocks.title: Seasonality
blocks.text: Edge IoT, including Consumer Solutions, has historically had higher sales in the first half of the fiscal year, primarily reflecting back-to-school and year-end holiday purchasing.

evidence.quote: higher sales typically occurring in the first half of our fiscal year, primarily reflecting back-to-school and year-end holiday purchasing

cells: Sold primarily to CSPs, OEMs, distributors, and enterprise organizations; some major customers buy under master purchase agreements, with deliveries scheduled against purchase orders and demand forecasts.

evidence.quote: Our Data Center portfolio is sold primarily to CSPs, OEMs, distributors and enterprise organizations.

cells: Sold primarily through OEMs, distributors, retailers, and third-party resellers serving industrial, commercial, and consumer markets.

evidence.quote: Our Edge IoT products are sold primarily through OEMs, distributors, retailers and third-party resellers

cells: One customer accounted for approximately 14% of consolidated revenue in fiscal year 2026; the filing excerpt does not identify that customer.

evidence.quote: In fiscal year 2026, one customer accounted for approximately 14% of our consolidated revenue.

blocks.title: Inferred buyer archetypes — not named customers
blocks.text: Inferred from the disclosed channels and uses: cloud-infrastructure procurement teams and enterprise storage buyers for Data Center products; industrial/commercial system integrators or OEM buyers and retail or consumer purchasers for Edge IoT. These are archetypes, not disclosed customer identities.
